name: A Sizeable Incident
source:
One bad experiment. One careless mistake. An entire academy where every step could be your last.

Lloyd's first day at Orion Academy was supposed to be ordinary. Instead, a simple visit to the science club leaves him shrunken in a school full of girls who could crush him without noticing, or decide to keep him on purpose.

Some are careless. Some are hungry. One has already decided he belongs to her.

Navigate the halls of Orion Academy from a whole new vantage point, dodging feet, mouths, and everything in between, all while trying to survive long enough to find the one who can turn you back before it's too late.

[From [url=https://taichigts.itch.io/a-sizeable-incident]Itch[/url]]
translation:
一次失败的实验，一个粗心的失误，让整座学园变成了每走一步都可能丧命的险境。

劳埃德在猎户座学园的第一天本该平平无奇，谁知只是去科学社转了一圈，他就意外缩小成了迷你小人，被困在满是女生的校园里——她们要么会在毫无察觉间一脚踩扁他，要么会蓄意将他据为己有。

有的人粗心大意，有的人饥肠辘辘，还有一个早已认定他是属于自己的私有物。

从截然不同的低矮视角穿梭于猎户座学园的走廊之间，躲避脚掌、唇齿以及其间的一切危险，竭力活下去，赶在一切无可挽回之前找到那个能把你变回原样的人吧。

[摘自[url=https://taichigts.itch.io/a-sizeable-incident]Itch[/url]]
